rca_of_the_issue: RCA validated by code review and browser evidence: model download failure previously could be treated like camera denial, causing the 5s denied-phase poll to reboot camera and blink the stream. The current implementation acquires camera first, leaves phase live on model errors, and only shows denied UI for actual getUserMedia failures. Evidence: model-blocked run aborted 6 model requests, made 1 fake camera stream, had 0 null/inactive stream samples, 0 denied overlay samples, and heartbeat POSTed camera_ok=true (200). Denied run had getUserMedia calls at poll intervals but MutationObserver recorded 0 retry overlay removals/additions after initial render.
